description: This file defines a text chunking service using LangChain's RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter. It provides a function to split large texts into smaller, manageable chunks, equipped with associated metadata, suitable for embedding and retrieval augmented generation (RAG). It leverages environment variables to configure chunk size and overlap.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] chunk_text( text: str, metadata: Dict[str, str], )
methods.description: Splits the input text into chunks with associated metadata, using configurable chunk size and overlap.
